description: The CLI coding agents installed through their OTHER route -- Homebrew, and npm for Claude Code -- so the identifiers 20-cli-agents cannot reach are exercised by a real install.
why: These four homebrew tokens read DID NOT APPEAR: 20-cli-agents and 25-python-agents install the same agents from npm and uv, so the Homebrew identifiers were catalogued and never produced by any run. A second route needs a second machine, because both routes claim the same binary name. Claude Code is here for the same reason in mirror image: 20-cli-agents installs it from the native installer, which leaves a shim and no npm row. Hermes Agent joins them for the same reason and with a wrinkle of its own: the formula token is `hermes-agent` while the command it installs is `hermes`, so nothing but a real install settles which of the two a homebrew_packages row renders. Muse Code's cask is here because 14-meta-muse installs it from Meta's own installer, and both put a `muse` on PATH; nothing else on this machine names it, so the token is the only witness.
